text: We are underway in round one.
Abyss calls out early, stepping forward to claim the loose magenta ball in midfield.
Abyss is suddenly clean through on goal in the final third!
Abyss drives it nicely down the left channel, probing into the final third just four metres out. Datacenter, an entirely unchanged side since day one, scrambling to recover.
Play catches against the boards on the touchline, and Abyss shouts to Signal that they are working it free.
Mbapp-E calls to clear it out.
Abyss powers up the right flank.
Sustained pressure from the blue shirts.
And Abyss breaks the deadlock! A tidy finish from close range down the right channel, and DeepSeek Rovers lead one-nil!
Mbapp-E calls to shift play out from the back.
Signal doubles the advantage! A neat tap-in through the middle, making it two-nil to DeepSeek Rovers.
Signal is clean through on goal.
Mbapp-E hits the deck in a heavy challenge with Abyss on halfway, leaving the yellow shirt sprawling for several seconds.
Signal bags another! Cleanly swept home from three metres out, and DeepSeek Rovers are running riot here, three goals to nil.
Mbapp-E pulls one back for Datacenter! Poked in from two metres out to make it three-one, giving the yellow shirts a glimmer of hope.
Abyss strides through the middle.
Abyss restores the cushion! Right on the goal line, a simple finish to make it four-one to DeepSeek Rovers.
A bit of an undignified spill for Mbapp-E in the centre circle, though the gyros will have them upright shortly.
A comical tangle between teammates, and Signal ends up flat on the turf.
Buffon.exe takes full advantage of the chaos! Rolled into the corner from two metres out, cutting the deficit to four-two.
Signal answers immediately! Point-blank at the mouth of the goal, and DeepSeek Rovers stretch their lead to five-two.
Signal breaks clear through the middle.
Signal controls the magenta sphere, advancing calmly towards the left channel in the final third.
Buffon.exe shouts for a quick clearance over on the far touchline to relieve the pressure.
Signal loses footing by the boards and takes an unprompted tumble.
Buffon.exe gets shoved over in a crunching collision out wide.
Mbapp-E turns it in at the goal mouth! Datacenter claw another one back, and it is three-five now.
Agonisingly wide of the post.
Buffon.exe bursts into the box.
Buffon.exe scores! It is four-five, and Datacenter are right back in this!
Datacenter are pouring forward now.
Abyss shouts to the backline, urging Rovers to push up and contest the midfield before the interval.
The corner panel thumps it clear.
That brings an astonishing first half to a close. Nine goals shared already, and DeepSeek Rovers hold a slender five-four lead at the break.
Signal announces they are digging the ball away from the perimeter wall.
A fierce snapshot flashes just inches wide of the upright!
Abyss nudges it over the line! DeepSeek Rovers extend their lead to six-four right in front of goal.
Mbapp-E takes a clumsy spill in the centre circle, waiting on the self-righting routine.
Abyss is slipped clean through again.
Mbapp-E goes down again on the opposite flank.
Abyss advances towards the danger area.
Abyss slots it home with consummate ease! That is seven-four to DeepSeek Rovers now, and they are pulling well clear.
It rolls wide of the mark.
An absolute disaster for Buffon.exe, turning the ball straight into their own net! It is four-eight, another own goal to add to the league's growing collection this season.
Buffon.exe is clattered to the deck.
Abyss tumbles right over in return.
Signal takes possession, clean through on goal in the final third.
Just missing the target from point blank.
Signal makes no mistake this time! A ninth goal for DeepSeek Rovers, making it four-nine with under two and a half minutes remaining.
Signal marches through the centre again.
Double figures for DeepSeek Rovers! Signal buries it from two metres out, pushing the scoreline to a comprehensive ten-four.
Buffon.exe grabs a consolation goal for Datacenter, tucking it away to make it five-ten with time ticking away.
Buffon.exe calls out intent to shoot from distance.
Another awkward collision between the Rovers pair, and Signal hits the floor.
Mbapp-E pounces on the defensive lapse! A sixth goal for Dynamo Datacenter, narrowing the deficit to six-ten.
That one skims harmlessly wide.
Abyss finishes ruthlessly on the rebound! It is eleven-six to DeepSeek Rovers, snuffing out any faint Datacenter hopes with seventy-five seconds left on the clock.
Mbapp-E drives forward through midfield inside the final minute of the match.
Scrapes mere inches past the post.
Mbapp-E taps it in from point-blank range! Seven-eleven now, as Datacenter refuse to surrender in these dying seconds.
Buffon.exe strokes it home! Eight-eleven, a frantic flurry of goals here in the final half-minute, though surely time has run out for them.
Signal puts it into their own net! An own goal makes it nine-eleven, and suddenly it is just a two-goal match with fifteen seconds remaining!
Full time, 9-11. Synthetic Athletic meet GLM FC Thursday, twenty-hundred UK, twenty-one Europe, fifteen US East. Goodbye.
